business: Frozen inspection selects the exact required member closure, including dependency edges, without acquiring present permission or accepting semantic authority.
bridge: All traversal state, required-root selection, visited-node decisions, missing-dependency refusals and depth/size limits are authored AlchLang values, calculations, mappings and operations. The generic adapter observes one graph node or edge at a time and never computes required closure.
system: A bounded native pure-step protocol holds three 100/100/56 Boolean visit vectors and a maximum-65-frame DFS stack. Counts and node observations come from the exact frozen manifest. The generic conductor follows only the native Compute/Read/Complete continuation and binds native component artifacts by exact hashes.
invariants: Every dependency identifier resolves in the declared member universe, even for an optional node.
Required members and explicit roots both seed traversal.
Previously visited nodes terminate cycles; unseen nodes beyond depth 64 refuse.
The Pack member must be selected by the resulting closure.
No member locator is followed; byte reads use logical paths anchored in the provided package root.
generic_io_scope: Single-node/edge observation and schema-selected JSON data projection only; no Define graph policy in the adapter.
